item.title: Customer Support Specialist
item.dc:creator:
Example Company
⚲ Worldwide
item.content:encoded:
Example Company builds practical tools for distributed teams and is looking for a customer support specialist to help customers succeed.

You will answer customer questions, investigate product issues, document clear steps, and work with product and engineering colleagues.

The role requires careful written communication, sound judgment, patience, and the ability to manage several support conversations.

Experience with customer support software and remote collaboration is helpful. You will contribute to a respectful, reliable customer experience while sharing recurring feedback with the wider team.

The post Customer Support Specialist appeared first on Jobspresso.
